statement: Unmarked torsion-free recognition fails already for an index-two extension of the rank-three free profinite group: an explicit Haran extension has an 18-element quotient needing three generators. Its outer involution preserves no (1,2) marking. Every invariant (0,4) marking has double-transposition cusp permutation, multiplier minus epsilon, and canonical character (l,a,b)=(1,-1,-1). Two explicit candidates fail in S_3 and S_4; D.29 constructs another invariant marking and identifies its extension with this one.
